target.statement: MorphMarkexp attains TPR@1% under Word-S/30% attack of 0.9600 on OPT-1.3B.
target.table_ref: Table 1, OPT-1.3B block, MorphMarkexp row, TPR@1% (Word-S/30%) column
target.dataset: C4 (400 samples; first 30 tokens as prompt, 200-230 generated tokens) with OPT-1.3B

compute.basis: Estimate rests on generating ~400 C4 samples for ~200-230 tokens each with OPT-1.3B on CPU, then applying a WordNet synonym attack and z-score detection; no training is required and the model/data are public, but the watermark and evaluation pipeline must be reimplemented.

blockers: No official code or configuration files are linked in the paper; MorphMark and the MarkLLM-style evaluation pipeline must be reimplemented.
Exact TPR@1% may depend on C4 split, tokenizer/model revisions, and WordNet synonym-replacement details.
The main cost is CPU autoregressive generation of roughly 80k tokens with OPT-1.3B; batching/quantization will strongly affect wall-clock time.
title: MorphMark: Flexible Adaptive Watermarking for Large Language Models
